text_block_list.text:
Hmm hmm. ♪ It's finally here, the
special sale day
for croquettes—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'm off!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Hi, Ines. You're just getting off work?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I still have to go to my next job, but I'm
going to
do a quick run on my way there!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I gotta utilize this time between shifts!
Bye now!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
It's nothing! Just that... well, isn't she just
the
picture of youthful energy?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Giving it a hundred percent to chase
your
dreams... Oh, to be young.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Let's give this break a hundred percent too!

text_block_list.text:
Oops, did that inspire you? I swear, kids
these
days.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'll do it for you, though. After all, I have
a strong
sense of responsibility.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Plus, I want to go for a run anyway.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What? Give this break... a hundred
percent?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Pfft... hahaha! Then I guess we better
rest like we
mean it!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll get some veggie croquettes
today.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
We eat veggie croquettes and
rejuvenate
ourselves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, Найс Нэйчер and I put all our
youthful
energy into training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
